comment.en: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Miscellaneous</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendments 13-16 and 19-24 had been withdrawn by the TRAN Committee.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ro:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Diverse
</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendamentele 13-16 și 19-24 au fost retrase de Comisia TRAN.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.cs:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Různé
</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Pn. 13–16 a 19–24 byly vzaty zpět výborem TRAN</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sl:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Razno
</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Odbor TRAN je umaknil predloge sprememb 13 do 16 in 19 do 24.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.fr:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Divers
</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Les amendements 13-16 et 19-24 ont été retirés par la commission TRAN.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ga:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Aon ghnó eile
</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Rinne Coiste TRAN na leasuithe 13-16 agus 19-24 a tharraingt siar.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sv:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Övriga frågor
</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Ändringsförslagen 13–16 och 19–24 hade dragits tillbaka av utskottet för transport och turism.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.hu: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Egyéb</title><remarkFreeText><translation>A 13–16. és a 19–24. módosítást a TRAN bizottság visszavonta.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.el:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Διάφορα
</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Οι τροπολογίες 13-16 και 19-24 αποσύρθηκαν από την επιτροπή TRAN.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.it:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Varie
</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Gli emendamenti 13-16 e 19-24 sono stati ritirati dalla commissione TRAN.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.es: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Varios</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Las enmiendas 13-16 y 19-24 han sido retiradas por la Comisión TRAN.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.pt:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Diversos
</title><remarkFreeText><translation>As alterações 13-16 e 19-24 foram retiradas pela Comissão TRAN.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.lv:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Dažādi
</title><remarkFreeText><translation>TRAN komiteja bija atsaukusi grozījumus Nr. 13-16 un Nr. 19-24.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
